functions.name: round_at
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION attendance_private.round_at(e events, t timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when e.status='published' and e.event_type='invitation' and coalesce((e.attendance_config->>'enabled')::boolean,false)
  then case when t >= (e.attendance_config->>'round_one')::timestamptz and t < (e.attendance_config->>'round_one')::timestamptz+attendance_private.duration(e.attendance_config) then 1
    when t >= (e.attendance_config->>'round_two')::timestamptz and t < (e.attendance_config->>'round_two')::timestamptz+attendance_private.duration(e.attendance_config) then 2 end end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attendance_results(p_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.can_edit_content() then raise exception 'Forbidden' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  return coalesce((select jsonb_agg(attendance_private.result(r)||jsonb_build_object('history',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(h)-'record_id' order by h.changed_at,h.id) from attendance_private.edits h where h.record_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb)) order by r.created_at,r.id)
    from attendance_private.records r join public.events e on e.id=r.event_id where e.code=p_code),'[]'::jsonb);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.editor_add_recovery()
 RETURNS TABLE(email text, state text, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'Admin required' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  return query select o.email,o.state,o.updated_at from public.editor_add_operations o
    where o.state not in ('granted','revoked') and not exists(select 1 from auth.users u join public.editor_users e on e.user_id=u.id where lower(u.email)=o.email)
    order by o.updated_at desc;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_invitation(p_code text, p_alias text)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.role_directory()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, email text, role text, status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not public.can_edit_content() then raise exception 'Content access required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return query select u.id,u.email::text,case when a.user_id is not null then 'admin' else 'editor' end,
 case when u.email_confirmed_at is not null then 'confirmed' when u.invited_at is not null then 'invited' else 'unconfirmed' end
 from auth.users u left join public.admin_users a on a.user_id=u.id left join public.editor_users e on e.user_id=u.id
 where a.user_id is not null or e.user_id is not null order by lower(u.email);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.valid_event_theme(value jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_typeof(value)='object' and value->'version'='1'::jsonb
    and jsonb_typeof(value->'primary')='string' and value->>'primary' ~ '^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$'
    and (value - 'version' - 'primary')='{}'::jsonb, false)
$function$

constraints.name: edits_record_id_fkey

constraints.definition: CHECK (round_one_at IS NOT NULL OR round_two_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: records_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: records_invitation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (invitation_id) REFERENCES event_guests(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: tokens_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: admin_users_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: editor_add_operations_target_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (target) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: editor_users_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: agenda_end_time_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (end_time IS NULL OR end_time ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'::text AND end_time > "time")

constraints.name: event_agenda_items_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: event_guests_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: event_guests_guest_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (guest_id) REFERENCES guests(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: primary_alias_exists
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id, primary_alias) REFERENCES invitation_aliases(event_guest_id, alias) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: event_image_registered
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (venue_image_path) REFERENCES venue_image_uploads(path) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: events_code_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (length(code) >= 1 AND length(code) <= 80 AND code ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'::text AND (code <> ALL (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'auth'::text, 'assets'::text, '404'::text, 'index'::text, 'login'::text, 'new'::text, 'edit'::text])))

constraints.name: events_default_invitation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (default_invitation_id) REFERENCES event_guests(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: events_duplicated_from_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (duplicated_from_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: events_invitation_location
constraints.definition: CHECK (event_type = 'congratulation'::text OR location_method = 'url'::text AND maps_url <> ''::text OR location_method = 'place'::text AND place_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,255}$'::text)

constraints.name: events_invitation_time
constraints.definition: CHECK (event_type = 'congratulation'::text OR starts_at IS NOT NULL AND ends_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(starts_at) AND isfinite(ends_at) AND ends_at > starts_at)

constraints.name: events_music_path_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (music_path IS NULL OR length(music_path) <= 500 AND music_path ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}/[0-9a-f-]{36}/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+[.]mp3$'::text)

constraints.name: invitation_aliases_event_guest_id_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_guest_id, event_id) REFERENCES event_guests(id, event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
